notes: Nill Download Manager 2.3.1 is a fixes release built from screen recordings of real downloads. Video started from the browser now takes the page's own stream data first — the quality picker fills at once and the file comes down through the multi-connection engine — while yt-dlp remains the fallback for pasted links and pages without usable data. A cookie-signature mismatch that made every start probe from scratch (up to ~27 seconds) is fixed; a stalled stream refreshes only its address and resumes from the byte it had reached instead of re-probing; pause and resume work in every state, including while connecting. Facebook's picker can no longer spin forever — it stops at 20 seconds with a plain message — its links are normalized and its downloads take the post's text as the file name; Facebook's instant page-data picker is still being finished. A video that never connected could previously not be deleted from the list at all; entries are now always removable, and a full disk stops a download at once with a clear sentence instead of retrying silently. The extension's file dialog is the same glass card as the video picker, update downloads carry their real file names, the completion dialog stays within the screen, the toolbar, menus and file rows carry a proper icon set, and the View menu's Dark Theme and Categories Sidebar toggles work. On Windows, list sorting and the glass file card are still to come.
